mfa.setupIntro: The administration is protected by a second step: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, …).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code with it, or type the key below.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.verifyIntro: Signed in as {email}. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
mfa.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app or a recovery code
mfa.recoveryIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe (not on the phone). Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
mfa.lostPhone: Lost your phone and the recovery codes? Another administrator can reset your two-factor login in Tools.
